articles.title: From Ancient China to a 3,010-Pound Scoop: The Wild History of Ice Cream
articles.summary: National Ice Cream Month is packed with surprising history. Did you know George Washington dropped serious cash on ice cream, or that a single scoop once weighed over 3,000 pounds? Your flavor choice might even reveal your personality.

articles.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Swings to Historic $927 Million Global Debut
articles.summary: Sony and Marvel's latest Spider-Man film shattered expectations with a $927 million worldwide opening weekend, the second-biggest ever. It dominated in China and set records on premium screens, proving Peter Parker still rules the box office.

articles.title: Marvel's 'Wonder Man' Canceled Despite Signed Contracts and Cleared Schedules, Co-Creator Reveals
articles.summary: Andrew Guest, co-creator of the Disney+ series 'Wonder Man,' took to TikTok to clarify that the show's cancellation was not a marketing stunt. Despite signed deals and a planned production start, Disney and Marvel pulled the plug, leaving the cast and crew stunned.
